description: Retrieve Sports Illustrated (SI.com) articles - section listings, individual article content, and search by keyword. Covers NBA, MLB, NFL, and other sports sections.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_section_articles: Get article listings from a section (nba, mlb, nfl, etc.); 参数: limit, section; 必填: 无
  - get_article: Get full content of a single article by URL; 参数: url; 必填: 无
  - search_articles: Search for articles by keyword within a section; 参数: query, section, limit; 必填: 无

limit.description:
Maximum number of articles to return.
各功能默认值：get_section_articles=20；search_articles=10

section.description:
Sports section to query (e.g., 'nba', 'mlb', 'nfl', 'college', 'soccer').
Used by get_section_articles and search_articles.

url.description:
Full URL of the SI.com article to fetch.
Required for get_article function.
Example: https://www.si.com/nba/free-agency/lebron-james-decision

query.description:
Search query to filter articles by headline or description.
Used by search_articles function.
